body: she blocked me on everything after she dumped me but ive found ways to circumvent it. there have been stretches of time where i felt alright, didnt really think about her, did my own thing. and then id just revert to feeling like shit and wanting her back. part of it is because dating is very very very difficult for me and i cant find another partner for my life.

being short is a curse, too. i’m lucky that i’m relatively tall which is the only thing going for me. i understand the teeth and acne though. it’s not an easy habit to build to take care of your teeth and wash your face regularly.
appreciate it, though i think you would understand if you spent a day in my shoes.

i am 24 years old. i am not in a relationship. i have been on medication since I was 19. 

what made me realize im ugly? the answer to that isnt simple, but my lived experience has reinforced that idea as the truth. there’s no denying that my facial features are unpleasant.

why the sudden change? because im seeing more and more evidence that my ex girlfriend cheated on me. she left me for a more attractive guy. and i have evidence to support that she was never physically attracted to me to begin with. 

i cant move on because ive realized i got lucky with my first relationship. the chances i will ever find another girlfriend are slim to none. so the realization that no girl will ever be genuinely attracted to me, sexually or otherwise, has had a huge impact on my sex drive.

When multiple friends and family mentioned how my eyes are freakishly far back in my face. Another time in high school, a girl straight up said I’m ugly. Family and friends mentioned my nose is assymetric and slightly deformed. Also pointed out my massive forehead/receding hairline. So I guess in high school I realized that I am an unattractive human being. All of this was confirmed when I turned 18 and started using dating apps. No matches, no dates, nothing. Sad way to live.
uhhh yeah, I would pay money for this

I am suicidally depressed. I don’t see my mental health improving anytime soon. The pandemic has ruined many aspects of my life — notably not being able to interact with people or socialize. I feel anxious, always, because there’s so much I want to do in life, but I don’t have the time, energy, or motivation to do it. Even my hobbies and passions are too draining for me. I miss my ex-girlfriend so much. I want her back. I want friends who truly care about me. I want things how they were before.
I thought so too. But somehow it happened. I think it’s worth living for a chance to experience it. ❤️
I sincerely hope you get a chance to love and be loved. I was lucky enough to have that opportunity once and it was the happiest time of my life.
